data.exact_reserve_text: Within the calendar year technical result, a surplus of GBP 2.4m (2014: GBP 1.0m) relates to the reassessment of net claims incurred for previous years.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Syndicate suffered losses on the Nebraska Storms in the prior year; this was cited as an adverse prior-year event although overall prior-year reassessment in 2015 was a net surplus.

named_events.loss_description: The prior year, although also relatively benign, suffered losses on the Nebraska Storms.
Tianjin explosions in China produced a very limited loss to the division (noted as having potential to impact several accounts).

data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 557 opened 2015 with gross claims outstanding of GBP 36.758m. During 2015 the syndicate recorded a net prioryear surplus of GBP 2.4m (release), attributed to favourable development in older years and minimal exposure to major catastrophes. Prior-year impacts noted include losses from the Nebraska storms, but overall the reassessment of prior years produced a net release. A gross prior-year movement figure was not disclosed; the reported quantified movement is net of reinsurance.
raw_causal_phrases: Within the calendar year technical result, a surplus of GBP 2.4m (2014: GBP 1.0m) relates to the reassessment of net claims incurred for previous years.
2015 was a relatively benign year for catastrophe events, with our main exposures being losses from the Nebraska Storms.
data.data_quality_notes: Gross opening claims outstanding taken from the Balance Sheet 'Claims outstanding' prior-year column. No explicit GROSS prior-year movement (movement in prior years - insurance liabilities) was located for Syndicate 557; the report explicitly states a NET prior-year surplus of GBP 2.4m which has been used as a last-resort fallback and is flagged as NET of reinsurance. Page numbers are approximate to the syndicate-specific notes (page 99). A gross claims development triangle for Syndicate 557 is present and captured in _claims_triangle; it could be used to derive a gross prior-year movement if required. Confidence is reduced for the prior-year movement because only the NET figure was available in the movement narrative.
